input:
A player tosses 2 fair coins. He wins ₹5 if 2 heads appear, ₹2 if one head appears and ₹1 if no head appears. Then the variance of his winning amount in ₹ is

Options:
A. 6
B. 5/2
C. 9/4
D. 17/2

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the variance of the random variable X (winning amount) when a player tosses 2 fair coins with defined payoffs for each outcome.

given_information.winnings: ₹5 if 2 heads (HH), ₹2 if 1 head (HT or TH), ₹1 if 0 heads (TT)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: The sample space has 4 equally likely outcomes. Build the probability distribution of X, then compute E(X) and E(X²) to find Var(X) = E(X²) - [E(X)]².

key_concepts: Sample space of 2 fair coin tosses
Probability distribution of a discrete random variable

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: List all outcomes, assign probabilities, build the probability distribution table, compute E(X), E(X²), and then Var(X).
logical_steps: Step 1: List sample space and assign outcomes to X values
Step 2: Find probabilities P(X=5), P(X=2), P(X=1)
